description: Compare 2 to 5 trucking companies side by side on safety, fleet size, insurance, and authority. Returns a comparison table: fleet size, driver count, safety rating, crash history, BASIC safety scores, authority status, insurance, and out-of-service rates. Use this for questions like 'which carrier is safer?', 'compare these trucking companies', 'which freight company should I use?', 'evaluate these carriers against each other', 'help me pick between these haulers', or any carrier vetting decision.

dot_numbers.description: 2-5 USDOT numbers, as an array or comma-separated string.

name: fmcsa_carrier_compare
